crossRefs.note: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
“Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

translations.web: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
translations.bsb: You whose clothes get hot when the land lies hushed under the south wind,
translations.kjv: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south
translations.asv: How thy garments are warm, When the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
